criteria.name: claim_quality
criteria.description: Slide titles are conclusion sentences, not generic topic labels.

criteria.name: proof_alignment
criteria.description: Each slide has one primary proof object that supports the title.

criteria.name: layout_variety
criteria.description: The contact sheet shows varied page rhythms and avoids mechanical template repetition.

criteria.name: density_readability
criteria.description: Pages are dense but readable, with clear hierarchy and no large empty areas.

criteria.name: source_discipline
criteria.description: Numbers carry source, unit, time, scope, and caveats where needed.

criteria.name: visual_system
criteria.description: Palette and emphasis colors are consistent with consulting-style semantics.

criteria.name: technical_quality
criteria.description: No garbled text, overlap, unreadable labels, or missing previews.
